title: CLCON/577/2017 of Smt Tivrakanta Sati Vs Naresh Kumar Haldyani AND OTHERS

paras.text:
CLCON No.577 of 2017
U.C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. Mangal Singh Chauhan, Advocate
for the petitioner.
By means of present contempt
petition, the petitioner seeks to punish the
respondent/contemnor for willful
disobedience of the judgment and order
dated 20.4.2017 passed by this Court in
WPSS No.828/2014.
The order sought to be executed is
being reproduced herein below for
convenience:
ëAccordingly, the writ petition is allowed.
Impugned order dated 29.6.2013 is quashed and
set-aside. However, liberty is reserved to the
respondents to proceed with the matter in
accordance with law.í
It is the submission of learned
counsel for the petitioner that the casual
approach on the part of respondent should
not be tolerated and strict action should be
initiated against the alleged contemnor.
One of the objectives of contempt
jurisdiction is the enforcement and
compliance of the order of the Court.
This Court, instead of issuing notices
to the respondents, reiterates the order
dated 20.4.2017 passed by this Court and
directs the respondents to comply with the
same within six weeks, failing which they
will be liable to face appropriate action
under the Contempt of Courts Act.
Petitioner is directed to place a copy
of this order, as also the order dated
20.4.2017 to remind the respondents that a
duty is cast upon them to do something,
which has not been done.
Contempt petition stands disposed of.
